title: ChunkAnchor
description: Keep chunks loaded when players are online - perfect for farms and redstone contraptions
body:
# ChunkAnchor

Keep your automated farms and redstone contraptions running! ChunkAnchor force-loads chunks, ensuring your builds continue working even when you're far away.

## Features

- **Simple Commands** - Create named anchors with `/chunkanchor add <name>`
- **Per-Player Namespaces** - Each player manages their own anchors
- **Configurable Area** - Default loads 7x7 chunks (49 chunks) per anchor
- **Visual Boundaries** - See exactly which chunks are loaded with `/chunkanchor show <name>`
- **Load Modes** - Choose between ALWAYS (24/7) or PLAYER_ONLINE loading per anchor
- **Enable/Disable** - Temporarily disable anchors without deleting them
- **Persistent Storage** - Anchors survive server restarts

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/chunkanchor add <name>` | Create anchor at your location |
| `/chunkanchor remove <name>` | Remove an anchor |
| `/chunkanchor list` | List all your anchors with status |
| `/chunkanchor show <name>` | Visualize anchor boundaries |
| `/chunkanchor mode <name> <mode>` | Set load mode (DEFAULT/ALWAYS/PLAYER_ONLINE) |
| `/chunkanchor enable <name>` | Enable a disabled anchor |
| `/chunkanchor disable <name>` | Disable an anchor |

**Alias:** `/ca`

## Load Modes

| Mode | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `DEFAULT` | Uses server's default from config |
| `ALWAYS` | Chunks stay loaded 24/7, even with no players online |
| `PLAYER_ONLINE` | Chunks only load when at least one player is online |

## Configuration

```yaml
# Maximum anchors per player
default-limit: 3

# Chunk radius (3 = 7x7 chunks)
chunk-radius: 3

# Visualization duration in seconds
show-duration: 30

# Default load mode (ALWAYS or PLAYER_ONLINE)
default-load-mode: PLAYER_ONLINE
```

## Permission

- `chunkanchor.use` - Access to all commands (default: op)

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.4+
- Java 21+
